sources.label: Personal Morphe patch bundle (Chefkoch ads/analytics/tracking removal)
sources.author: 0x0day-0wl
patch_list: Hides banner, native, interstitial and sponsored ad tiles by treating the user as ad-free, the same state a Chefkoch PLUS subscriber has. Also skips the ad-consent (CMP) prompt.
Drops Firebase Analytics events and user properties before they leave the app. Other telemetry (Snowplow, Audix) is handled by the Remove tracking patch.
Neuters the app tracking middleware: no Snowplow events, no Admo Audix targeting and no Firebase tracking state changes are processed.
